description: Creates a workout from existing exercise and rest instances. Use when the user wants to build a custom workout. Provide either exercise_map (ordered instance IDs from create_exercise_instance and create_rest_instance) or instances (objects that carry an existing instance ID); neither takes exercise definitions. Not for building from exercises in one call (use build_workout). Workout cannot start or end with rest. Returns the new workout ID.

category_ids.description: Workout category IDs from list_workout_categories, e.g. ["63c9…"].

description.description: Short workout description, saved as the English (en-US) text.

exercise_map.description: Ordered workout steps as instance IDs, e.g. [{"instance_id": "…"}]. Create them with create_exercise_instance and create_rest_instance. The first and last steps can't be rest.

instance_id.description: Instance ID from create_exercise_instance or create_rest_instance.

instances.description: Ordered steps as existing instance references: each object carries an instance ID as "_id" or "instance_id", e.g. [{"instance_id": "…"}]. Not exercise definitions (build_workout takes those). Same rules as exercise_map.

name.description: Workout name, e.g. "20-Min Full Body HIIT".

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

visibility.description: Who sees it: "public" shows it to members and in public lists; "private" keeps it to the team.

name: create_workout
title: Create workout
